data.hypothesis: For sufficiently large grids, independent cells on each anti-diagonal can be distributed with static OpenMP worksharing; synchronization is needed only between dependent diagonals. Retaining the original row-wise implementation below a size threshold avoids parallel overhead on small workloads.
data.notes: The anti-diagonal recurrence uses two O(n) buffers and applies the modulus after combining the at-most-two predecessor values. The controller should evaluate correctness and performance.
transformations: Kept the original row-wise DP for n < 256 to preserve the low-overhead path for small workloads.
For larger n, computed the DP in anti-diagonal wavefront order so cells within each diagonal can be processed independently.
Used one OpenMP parallel region with static worksharing per diagonal and synchronization before swapping the two rolling buffers.
